articles.title: New phpAfterShell Attack Bypasses PHP2Shell Fix to Enable Remote Code Execution
articles.summary:
A new PHP attack dubbed phpAfterShell can lead to unauthenticated remote code execution on vulnerable servers, even if they have the October patches for PHP2Shell. Researchers at Depthfirst disclosed the flaw on November 19 and demonstrated how it could be combined with a separate bug in PHP to run code remotely. The vulnerability, tracked as […]

articles.title: Critical VMware vCenter Flaws Let Hackers Bypass Authentication and Access Servers
articles.summary:
Broadcom has released fixes for five VMware flaws, and one lets anyone with network access to vCenter skip login. Broadcom published the advisory, VMSA-2026-0009, on November 19, 2026. It covers vCenter, SDDC Manager, and VMware Tools. CVSS scores range from 6.7 to 9.8, and Broadcom has listed no workarounds. The most critical flaw is CVE-2026-123890, an authentication […]

articles.title: PHP Warns of Critical Security Flaws Affecting All Supported Versions, Urges Users to Update
articles.summary:

The team urged website operators and hosting providers to update promptly. The critical flaws require non-default settings or uncommon setups, so not every installation faces the same risk. The […]

articles.title: Meta AI Agent Muse Reads Encrypted Messages Through Android Notifications and Mac Permissions
articles.summary:
Meta’s AI agent Muse read Signal message text on Android phones and Macs without directly connecting to the encrypted messaging app, Reuters reported on November 18. The investigation found that Muse could use Android notifications and macOS permissions to see text already displayed on a device. The tests did not show that Muse broke Signal’s […]

articles.summary:

articles.summary:
